policies.evidencePolicy: A behavioral record is a test-runner command (swift test ..., bun test ..., vitest run ..., or mise run <task containing test>) with exit code 0 and every count > 0. For XCTest record the 'Executed N tests, with 0 failures' line with N > 0; for swift-testing the 'Test run with N tests passed' line with N > 0 only when the filter selects swift-testing tests. mise run web:check is not a behavioral record. bun test src and vitest run are recorded separately. An env-gated skip is never evidence; the live agent-gateway test (LiveServedAgenticSearchTests) records only the XCTest Executed N > 0 count of the positive run, and its swift-testing 0-tests line is not counted. Every command is teed into the plan's evidence directory and each record gives the complete log path and the final exit status.
policies.evidenceLayout: Evidence lives under tmp/release-0-1-17/<planId-prefix> (P1..P4), gitignored by tmp/. A retry attempt may use an attempt subdirectory inside the plan's own directory. A plan never writes another plan's evidence directory.
policies.editProtocol: Index 'Edit protocol': pre/post shasum per edit in tmp/release-0-1-17/<P#>/hashes.txt, an immutable intent snapshot intent.md written before the first edit, drift handling (re-read, re-apply only own intent, note drift), edit only own writePaths, peer compile/lint failures are not blockers (rerun after peers land; cross-plan fixes go to P4), no git write operations, no worktrees or branches, do not create or touch .riela/, each plan updates only the Progress Log in its own plan file. Never print OPENROUTER_API_KEY or any credential (presence check only); never copy machine-local absolute paths into committed files.
policies.artifactPolicy: artifactRoots are copied unchanged from the accepted plans: tmp/release-0-1-17/<P#> for every plan, web/dist and web/src-tauri/target for P3 and P4 (vite build from mise run web:check and cargo output from mise run tauri:check). All are gitignored. Authored files (sources, tests, version files, README.md, plan files) are never artifact roots.
policies.protectedPaths: No plan edits .riela/, api-key-expiration work, NoteStoreSchema or any store schema, web/src/styles.css, web/src/workspace.css, web/src/index.tsx, web/src/App.tsx, web/index.html, Sources/AppCore/AgentGatewaySubscription.swift, Sources/AppCore/ClaudeSubscriptionExecution.swift, Sources/AppServer/*, mise.toml, docker/, web/src-tauri/capabilities/, any impl-plans/active/*-dispatch.json, signing/notarization/cask scripts or ../homebrew-tap. design-docs/ is read-only except P2's conditional one-line AI13 'Profile additions' entry for a bounded allowance. The Step 2 design-doc edits are committed in this checkpoint, so P2 design-diff.log and P4 guard-design-docs.log start empty.
policies.releasePolicy: No release, tag, GitHub release, signing, notarization, cask or tap action. The operator runs .agents/skills/macos-cask-release/SKILL.md after this run.
policies.liveGatePolicy: Live agent-gateway runs need OPENROUTER_API_KEY, network access and a non-nested Seatbelt context; a missing key or a 'sandbox-exec:' nested-sandbox failure is recorded as blocked with the exact reason, never as passed. search:test-live needs Docker through colima (mise run search:docker, search:up, search:test-live, then search:down); if unavailable, record 'blocked: <exact error>'.
policies.escalationPolicy: P2 may add only the three AI13 bounded allowances (global file-read-metadata, file-lock on the workspace subpath, individual file-read* literals for non-system dylibs), each confirmed by a Sandbox log denial, documented in AI13 and asserted in a test. Any other needed allowance stops P2 as 'blocked: needs user decision' via design-docs/user-qa/ai-agent-runtime-and-ui.md.

P1: AgentInvocationError.publicDiagnostic is an anchored allowlist (.notConfigured -> 'agent runtime is not configured'; every .unavailable -> 'agent runtime is unavailable'; .failed passes only the eight pinned strings, else 'agent request failed').

designDecisionsAndRationale: Root cause per AI13: Seatbelt matches the physical path, but the profile granted the standardized (not realpath) Homebrew symlink, /etc instead of /private/etc, and no TLS/DNS mach services; the subscription profiles already carry the identical working rules.
realpath(3) with the existing realpath+free idiom instead of URL.resolvingSymlinksInPath(), which can rewrite /private/var to /var.
Public diagnostics are an exact allowlist so no stderr, provider text, path or secret can leak; every unavailable maps to one reason (DR-L1).
agenticSearch moves to a new extension file and the log sink is a defaulted stored property to respect the 1000-line limit without an init change.

Settings fix is two scoped light-theme rules with the background shorthand so the result does not depend on the legacy dark cascade; selected rule follows primary at equal specificity (0,3,1) (W16, accepted divergence DR-L2).

Waves: P1 and P2 both edit AppCore, so P2 depends on P1 (P1's diagnostics also make P2's baseline live run informative); P3 is web-only and parallel; the Version.swift bump and integration run last in P4.
intentionalTradeoffs: Duplicate /private/etc and mach-lookup rules in subscription profiles are left as harmless duplicates.
Light theme applies unconditionally; legacy dark base is untouched, so dark behavior is unchanged (DR-L2).
The no-reply sandbox-start classification is a prefix check on stderr; the stderr text itself is never surfaced.
Bounded escalation may block P2 for a user decision rather than widen the sandbox.
supportedEdgeCases: Gateway configured through a Homebrew bin symlink into the keg.
Missing gateway binary in served mode -> unavailable -> 'agent runtime is unavailable'.
sandbox-exec launch failure with leading whitespace before 'sandbox-exec:'.
.failed messages with suffixes, non-numeric exit codes, trailing spaces, secrets or paths -> 'agent request failed'.
Empty query keeps invalid_request mapping and writes one log line; nil invoker -> agent-unavailable with no log; success -> no log.
Selected preset remains distinguishable from unselected primary buttons; hover and disabled states.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Sandbox allowances beyond the three bounded AI13 escalations (user decision).
Dark-theme switch or legacy dark base styling.
tauri:check off macOS, live tests without OPENROUTER_API_KEY or network, and search:test-live without Docker/colima (recorded as blocked, never passed).
